title: Intent to Sole Source- Mustang Dynamometer
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE
detail_text: Intent to sole source to Mustang Dynameter, for Mustang Dynameter emissions testing equipment. This is not a solicitation and quotes are not being accepted at the moment. 355 LRS/LGLOR is requesting the procurement of a Mustang Dynameter Upgrade. The Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source under the authority of FAR 6.103-1. Government intends to solicit to procure the below listed item. The Government does not possess or cannot provide the data necessary to manufacture the item: Mustang Dynameter repair/ component upgrade All responsible sources may identify their interest and provide capability statements in response to this notice. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. However, all responses received within 2 work days after date of publication of this sources sought notice will be considered by the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete with this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Approval of a source is required. 355 CONS will not delay award while Source Approval is pending. The time required for approval of a new source is normally such that an award cannot be delayed pending approval of a new source. This notice serves as the synopsis and notice of intent to sole-source. The Government does not possess the necessary information to manufacture the equipment/items solicited hereunder from any source other than the OEM. See below for item specifics: CLIN 0001 ITEM: PowerDyne Control System- QTY:1 CLIN 0002 ITEM: Neccessory Package - QTY: 1 CLIN 0003 ITEM: 5-Gas analyzer system, heavy duty for continuous sampling- QTY: 1 CLIN 0004 ITEM: Onsite installation assistance and training - QTY: 1
